source_string: In addition, you will be able to access them on any device you use to play Minecraft!
translation: Dorbenaben kannst du dorto op jeedwelk Gerät togriepen, wo du Minecraft speelst!

source_string: Content purchased through a partner store will be available as long as your device is signed in to your partner store account.
translation: Taske, de dör en Partner-Buutick köfft is, blifft verfügboor, so lang dien Gerät bi dien Partner-Buutick-Account anmellt is.

source_string: This Xbox Live account will not be the primary account for this device if you do not transfer this device's purchases to this account. You will not automatically sign in when you start Minecraft.
translation: Disse Xbox Live-Account ward nich den Hööftaccount för dit Gerät, wenn du de Köp vun dit Gerät nich na disse Account övertregst. Du warrst nich automaatsch anmellt, wenn du Minecraft startst.

source_string: %1 and %2	## comment.like(s) will be inserted at %1 and comment.comment(s) at %2
translation: %1 un %2	## comment.like(s) will be inserted at %1 and comment.comment(s) at %2

source_string: You can also wear a Pumpkin on your head. This won't give you any :armor: but will make it so Endermen won't get mad when you look at them.
translation: Du kannst ok en Kürbis op'n Kopp draogen. Dat gifft di keen :armor:, aver Endermen warrt nich meer op di argerlich, wenn du se ankiekst.

source_string: Minecraft is a game about placing blocks to build anything you can imagine. At night monsters come out, so make sure to build a shelter before that happens.
translation: Minecraft is en Speel, bi dat du Blöcke sett, üm allens to boen, wat du di vörstellen kannst. Nachts kaamt Monster rut, dorüm sorg dor för, dat du en Ünnerkunft boen hest, ehr dat passeert.

source_string: Use the mouse to look around.
translation: Nütz de Muus, üm rüm to kieken.

source_string: Touch and drag along the screen to look around.
translation: Tipp un treck över den Scherm, üm rüm to kieken.

source_string: Press :_input_key.forward: twice in rapid succession or press :_input_key.sprint: to sprint. While you hold :_input_key.forward:, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Drük :_input_key.forward: tweemaol gau achteranner or drük :_input_key.sprint:, üm to sprinten. Wielt du :_input_key.forward: fasthöllst, sprintst du wieder, bit du weniger as :shank::shank::shank: hest.

source_string: Push :_gamepad_stick_left: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :_gamepad_stick_left: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Treck :_gamepad_stick_left: tweemaol gau vörwarts, üm to sprinten. Wielt du :_gamepad_stick_left: vörwarts hollst, sprintst du wieder, bit du weniger as :shank::shank::shank: hest.

source_string: Press :touch_forward: twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :touch_forward:, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Drük :touch_forward: tweemaol gau achteranner, üm to sprinten. Wielt du :touch_forward: fasthöllst, sprintst du wieder, bit du weniger as :shank::shank::shank: hest.

source_string: Push :rift_left_stick: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :rift_left_stick: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Treck :rift_left_stick: tweemaol gau vörwarts, üm to sprinten. Wielt du :rift_left_stick: vörwarts hollst, sprintst du wieder, bit du weniger as :shank::shank::shank: hest.

source_string: Push :windowsmr_left_stick: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :windowsmr_left_stick: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Treck :windowsmr_left_stick: tweemaol gau vörwarts, üm to sprinten. Wielt du :windowsmr_left_stick: vörwarts hollst, sprintst du wieder, bit du weniger as :shank::shank::shank: hest.

source_string: Hold :_input_key.attack: to mine and chop using your hand or whatever you are holding. You may need to craft a tool to mine some blocks.
translation: Hool :_input_key.attack: fast, üm mit dien Hand or wat du fasthöllst to graven un to hauen. Villicht musst du en Wiärktüüg maken, üm en Deel Blöcke to graven.

source_string: Touch and hold the screen on a block to mine and chop using your hand or whatever you are holding. You may need to craft a tool to mine some blocks.
translation: Tipp un hool den Scherm op en Block fast, üm mit dien Hand or wat du fasthöllst to graven un to hauen. Villicht musst du en Wiärktüüg maken, üm en Deel Blöcke to graven.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, use :_input_key.use: to use that item or press :_input_key.drop: to drop it.
translation: Wenn du en Giëgenstand in de Hand hollst, nütz :_input_key.use:, üm em to bruken, or drük :_input_key.drop:, üm em fallen to laten.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, use :_input_key.use: to use that item or press :_input_key.drop: to drop it.
translation: Wenn du en Giëgenstand in de Hand hollst, nütz :_input_key.use:, üm em to bruken, or drük :_input_key.drop:, üm em fallen to laten.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, use :rift_right_grab: to use that item or press :rift_right_stick: to drop it.
translation: Wenn du en Giëgenstand in de Hand hollst, nütz :rift_right_grab:, üm em to bruken, or drük :rift_right_stick:, üm em fallen to laten.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, use :windowsmr_left_trigger: to use that item or press :windowsmr_right_grab: to drop it.
translation: Wenn du en Giëgenstand in de Hand hollst, nütz :windowsmr_left_trigger:, üm em to bruken, or drük :windowsmr_right_grab:, üm em fallen to laten.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, touch the screen to use that item or touch and hold the item in your hotbar to drop it.
translation: Wenn du en Giëgenstand in de Hand hollst, tipp den Scherm, üm em to bruken, or tipp un hool den Giëgenstand in dien Gaubalken fast, üm em fallen to laten.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To sneak, hold :_input_key.sneak:.
translation: Sliken is heel nütslich in Minecraft, dat höllt di dorvun af, vun en Block to fallen, un versteckt dien Naamschild. Üm to sliken, hool :_input_key.sneak: fast.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, press :_input_key.sneak: or click :_gamepad_stick_right:.
translation: Sliken is heel nütslich in Minecraft, dat höllt di dorvun af, vun en Block to fallen, un versteckt dien Naamschild. Üm Sliken ümtoschalten, drük :_input_key.sneak: or klick :_gamepad_stick_right:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, tap :touch_sneak:.
translation: Sliken is heel nütslich in Minecraft, dat höllt di dorvun af, vun en Block to fallen, un versteckt dien Naamschild. Üm Sliken ümtoschalten, tipp :touch_sneak:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, press :rift_X:.
translation: Sliken is heel nütslich in Minecraft, dat höllt di dorvun af, vun en Block to fallen, un versteckt dien Naamschild. Üm Sliken ümtoschalten, drük :rift_X:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, press :windowsmr_right_stick:.
translation: Sliken is heel nütslich in Minecraft, dat höllt di dorvun af, vun en Block to fallen, un versteckt dien Naamschild. Üm Sliken ümtoschalten, drük :windowsmr_right_stick:.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the mouse to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sprinten in't Water lett di swemmen. Nütz de Muus, üm de Richtung to stüern, in de du swemmst.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the :_gamepad_stick_right: to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sprinten in't Water lett di swemmen. Nütz :_gamepad_stick_right:, üm de Richtung to stüern, in de du swemmst.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Touch and drag along the screen to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sprinten in't Water lett di swemmen. Tipp un treck över den Scherm, üm de Richtung to stüern, in de du swemmst.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the :rift_right_stick: to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sprinten in't Water lett di swemmen. Nütz :rift_right_stick:, üm de Richtung to stüern, in de du swemmst.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the :windowsmr_right_stick: to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sprinten in't Water lett di swemmen. Nütz :windowsmr_right_stick:, üm de Richtung to stüern, in de du swemmst.

source_string: Press :_input_key.inventory: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Drük :_input_key.inventory:, üm dat Rezeptbook un dat Wiärk-Gitter to bedreden.

source_string: Press :_input_container.crafting: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Drük :_input_container.crafting:, üm dat Rezeptbook un dat Wiärk-Gitter to bedreden.

source_string: Tap the Inventory Button to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Tipp den Inventar-Knop, üm dat Rezeptbook un dat Wiärk-Gitter to bedreden.

source_string: Press :rift_B: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Drük :rift_B:, üm dat Rezeptbook un dat Wiärk-Gitter to bedreden.

source_string: Press :windowsmr_left_grab: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Drük :windowsmr_left_grab:, üm dat Rezeptbook un dat Wiärk-Gitter to bedreden.

source_string: Arrange items from your Inventory or Hotbar in the crafting grid in the shape of an item recipe.
translation: Ornen Giëgenstänne ut dien Inventar or Gaubalken in't Wiärk-Gitter, in de Form vun en Giëgenstand-Rezept.

source_string: If the recipe is correct the item you are attempting to craft will appear in the Output Slot to the right of the Crafting Grid. Take it from the Output Slot and put it in your Inventory. You can now use the item.
translation: Wenn dat Rezept richtig is, warrt de Giëgenstand, den du maken wist, in den Utgaov-Platz rechts vun't Wiärk-Gitter opduken. Nimm em ut den Utgaov-Platz un legg em in dien Inventar. Nu kannst du den Giëgenstand bruken.

source_string: There are many recipes and for some you will need a larger Crafting Grid than the 2x2 grid that you start with.
translation: Dat gifft veel Rezepte, un för en Deel brükst du en gröttere Wiärk-Gitter as dat 2x2-Gitter, mit dat du anfangst.

source_string: Craft 4 Wooden Planks into a Crafting Table and place it in the world.
translation: Wiärk 4 Holtplanken to en Wiärkbank un sett se in de Wiält.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Drük :_input_key.use: op en Wiärkbank in de Wiält, üm Togang to en 3x3-Wiärk-Gitter to kriegen.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Drük :_input_key.use: op en Wiärkbank in de Wiält, üm Togang to en 3x3-Wiärk-Gitter to kriegen.

source_string: Press :rift_right_grab: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Drük :rift_right_grab: op en Wiärkbank in de Wiält, üm Togang to en 3x3-Wiärk-Gitter to kriegen.

source_string: Press :windowsmr_left_trigger: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Drük :windowsmr_left_trigger: op en Wiärkbank in de Wiält, üm Togang to en 3x3-Wiärk-Gitter to kriegen.

source_string: Tap on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Tipp op en Wiärkbank in de Wiält, üm Togang to en 3x3-Wiärk-Gitter to kriegen.

source_string: On the left side of the screen you will see the Recipe Book, which is good if you don't know a recipe or want to quickly craft a recipe that you already know. You will also see the Crafting grid on the right side of the screen above your Inventory.
translation: Op de linke Siet vun'n Scherm sühst du dat Rezeptbook, dat gut is, wenn du en Rezept nich kennst or gau en Rezept wiärken wist, dat du all kennst. Du sühst ok dat Wiärk-Gitter op de rechte Siet vun'n Scherm över dien Inventar.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, :_input_key.attack: the recipe to load it into the crafting grid, then take it from the Output Slot to the right of the Crafting Grid and put it in your Inventory. :_input_key.use: the recipe to auto-craft, this automatically crafts one set and puts it in your inventory. SHIFT + :_input_key.use: the recipe to auto-craft a whole stack.
translation: Wenn du dat Rezept funnen hest, dat du wiärken wist, :_input_key.attack: dat Rezept, üm dat in't Wiärk-Gitter to laden, denn nimm dat ut den Utgaov-Platz rechts vun't Wiärk-Gitter un legg dat in dien Inventar. :_input_key.use: dat Rezept, üm autowiärken to laten, dat autowiärkt automaatsch een Set un leggt dat in dien Inventar. SHIFT + :_input_key.use: dat Rezept, üm en heelen Stapel autowiärken to laten.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, press :_gamepad_face_button_down: on the recipe to auto-craft, this automatically crafts one set and puts it in your inventory. Press :_gamepad_face_button_up: on the recipe to auto-craft a whole stack.
translation: Wenn du dat Rezept funnen hest, dat du wiärken wist, drük :_gamepad_face_button_down: op dat Rezept, üm autowiärken to laten, dat autowiärkt automaatsch een Set un leggt dat in dien Inventar. Drük :_gamepad_face_button_up: op dat Rezept, üm en heelen Stapel autowiärken to laten.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, tap the recipe to load it into the crafting grid, then tap the item in the output slot to craft it. Press and hold the item in the output slot to craft continuously.
translation: Wenn du dat Rezept funnen hest, dat du wiärken wist, tipp dat Rezept, üm dat in't Wiärk-Gitter to laden, denn tipp den Giëgenstand in den Utgaov-Platz, üm em to wiärken. Hool den Giëgenstand in den Utgaov-Platz fast, üm ununnerbroken to wiärken.

source_string: When the :craftable_toggle_on: is on, the Recipe Book shows all of the recipes that you have ingredients for. When the :craftable_toggle_off: is off, the Recipe Book shows every recipe in the game, even if you can't craft it. Check the tabs or search if you are looking for something specific. In Creative Mode some recipes will be collapsed inside lists. Opening the list will expand it and show you all of the recipes inside.
translation: Wenn :craftable_toggle_on: an is, wiest dat Rezeptbook all Rezepte, för de du de Zutaten hest. Wenn :craftable_toggle_off: uut is, wiest dat Rezeptbook jeed Rezept in't Speel, ok wenn du dat nich wiärken kannst. Kiek de Tabs an or söök, wenn du wat Bestimmtes söchst. In de Kreativwise sünd en Deel Rezepte in Listen tosammenklappt. Wenn du de List apenst, klappt se ut un wiest di all Rezepte dorbinnen.

source_string: To fly when in Creative Mode, Tap :_input_key.jump: twice quickly. To exit flying, repeat the action. To fly faster, tap :_input_key.forward: twice in rapid succession while flying. When in flying mode, you can press :touch_fly_up: to move up and :touch_fly_down: to move down.
translation: Üm in de Kreativwise to flegen, tipp :_input_key.jump: tweemaol gau. Üm dat Flegen to verlaten, wedderhaal de Akschoon. Üm gauer to flegen, tipp :_input_key.forward: tweemaol gau achteranner, wielt du flüggst. In de Flegen-Wise kannst du :touch_fly_up: drükken, üm hooch to gaon, un :touch_fly_down:, üm daal to gaon.

source_string: How to Play : Eye Of Ender
translation: Wie speel ik : Eye of Ender

source_string: - Old worlds limited in size and height.
translation: - Olle Wiälten begrenzt in Grötte un Hööchde.

source_string: -Mob Loot: Controls whether mobs will drop loot when they die.
translation: -Wesen-Beute: Stüert, ob Wesen Beute fallen laot, wenn se doodgaot.

source_string: -Mob Griefing: Prevents mobs from destroying the world.
translation: -Wesen-Verwüsten: Verhinnert, dat Wesen de Wiält verwüst.

source_string: -Tile Drops: When this setting is turned on, blocks will drop themselves when they break.
translation: -Block-Fallen: Wenn disse Instellen an is, laot Blöcke sik sülvst fallen, wenn se afbraken warrt.

source_string: -Entities Drop Loot: Controls whether things like minecarts and armor stands will drop themselves when they are broken.
translation: -Wesen laot Beute fallen: Stüert, ob Dinge as Minecarts un Rüstenstänner sik sülvst fallen laot, wenn se afbraken warrt.

source_string: -Weather Cycle: The weather will not change when this setting is turned off.
translation: -Wäder-Kreislaop: Dat Wäder ännert sik nich, wenn disse Instellen uut is.

source_string: How to Play : Host and Player Options
translation: Wie speel ik : Gastgäber- un Speeler-Optionen

source_string: The HUD shows information about your status, your health, your remaining oxygen (when you are underwater), your hunger level, and your armor (if you are wearing any).
translation: Dat HUD wiest Informatschonen över dien Status, dien Gesundheid, dien Rest-Sauerstoff (wenn du unner Water büst), dien Hungeriveau un dien Rüsten (wenn du een dröögst).

source_string: If you lose some health but have at least nine :shank:, your health will replenish. Eating food will replenish your :shank:.
translation: Wenn du en Deel Gesundheid verlüst, aver noch tominst neegn :shank: hest, füllt sik dien Gesundheid wedder op. Eten füllt dien :shank: wedder op.

source_string: Press and hold :_input_key.use: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Drük un hool :_input_key.use: fast, wielt du en Stück Eten hollst, üm dat to eten.

source_string: Press and hold :_input_key.use: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Drük un hool :_input_key.use: fast, wielt du en Stück Eten hollst, üm dat to eten.

source_string: Press and hold :rift_right_grab: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Drük un hool :rift_right_grab: fast, wielt du en Stück Eten hollst, üm dat to eten.

source_string: Press and hold :windowsmr_left_trigger: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Drük un hool :windowsmr_left_trigger: fast, wielt du en Stück Eten hollst, üm dat to eten.

source_string: Press and hold a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Drük un hool en Stück Eten fast, üm dat to eten.

source_string: You must watch your hunger level while adventuring, your hunger level is represented on your HUD with :shank:. The hunger level decreases as you explore. Certain activities will decrease hunger level at a faster rate, such as sprinting. You can replenish your hunger level by eating food. Some foods are more nourishing than others and will fill up more :shank:. When you get your hunger level up to maximum, the last food you ate applies a saturation value. Saturation is a hidden number that gives you an extra bonus to your hunger level.
translation: Du musst dien Hungeriveau bewaken, wielt du op Aventüür büst, dat ward op dien HUD mit :shank: wiest. Dat Hungeriveau sinkt, wielt du utfünnigst. Bestimmte Akschonen loot dat Hungeriveau gauer sinken, as bv. Sprinten. Du kannst dien Hungeriveau wedder opfüllen, in dat du Eten iss. En Deel Eten is nährrieker as anners un füllt mehr :shank: op. Wenn dien Hungeriveau to't Maximum kummt, gifft dat leste Eten, dat du eeten hest, en Sättigungs-Weert. Sättigung is en versteckt Tall, de di en extra Bonus op dien Hungeriveau gifft.

source_string: The Experience Bar is also shown on the HUD. The number shows your current Experience Level, and the bar indicates how many Experience Points are required to increase your Experience Level.
translation: De Erfaorungsbalken ward ok op dien HUD wiest. De Tall wiest dien aktuellen Erfaorungsnivau, un de Balken wiest, wo veel Erfaorungspunkte nödig sünd, üm dien Erfaorungsnivau to stiegen.

source_string: Experience Points are gained by collecting Experience Orbs. You can get Experience Orbs from activities such as killing mobs, mining certain blocks, and more! Don't leave any Experience Orbs behind, you're going to need them. Move near Experience Orbs to collect them.
translation: Erfaorungspunkte kriggst du, in dat du Erfaorungskuëgeln sammelst. Du kriggst Erfaorungskuëgeln vun Akschonen as dat Doodmaken vun Wesen, dat Graven vun bestimmte Blöcke un mehr! Laat keen Erfaorungskuëgeln liggen, du warrst se nödig hebben. Gah nah bi Erfaorungskuëgeln, üm se to sammeln.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Scroll the mouse wheel to change the item in your hand.
translation: De Gaubalken wiest de Giëgenstänne, de du bruken kannst. Scroll dat Muus-Rad, üm den Giëgenstand in dien Hand to wesseln.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Use :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: and :_input_key.cycleItemRight: to change the item in your hand.
translation: De Gaubalken wiest de Giëgenstänne, de du bruken kannst. Nütz :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: un :_input_key.cycleItemRight:, üm den Giëgenstand in dien Hand to wesseln.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Tap items in your hotbar to change the item in your hand.
translation: De Gaubalken wiest de Giëgenstänne, de du bruken kannst. Tipp Giëgenstänne in dien Gaubalken, üm den Giëgenstand in dien Hand to wesseln.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Press :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: to change the item in your hand.
translation: De Gaubalken wiest de Giëgenstänne, de du bruken kannst. Drük :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal:, üm den Giëgenstand in dien Hand to wesseln.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Press :rift_left_trigger: or :rift_left_grab: to change the item in your hand.
translation: De Gaubalken wiest de Giëgenstänne, de du bruken kannst. Drük :rift_left_trigger: or :rift_left_grab:, üm den Giëgenstand in dien Hand to wesseln.

source_string: This screen shows the items that are available for use in your hand, and all of the other items that you are carrying. Your armor is also shown here.
translation: Disse Scherm wiest de Giëgenstänne, de du in de Hand bruken kannst, un all anner Giëgenstänne, de du bi di dröögst. Dien Rüsten ward ok hier wiest.

source_string: Use :mouse_left_button: to pick up the item that is under the cursor. If there is more than one item here this will pick them all up, or you can use :mouse_right_button: to pick up just half of them.
translation: Nütz :mouse_left_button:, üm den Giëgenstand optonemmen, de ünner den Cursor is. Wenn dor mehr as een Giëgenstand is, nimmst du all op, or du kannst :mouse_right_button: bruken, üm bloots de Hälfte optonemmen.

source_string: Use :_gamepad_face_button_down: to pick up the item that is under the cursor. If there is more than one item here this will pick them all up, or you can use :_gamepad_face_button_left: to pick up just half of them.
translation: Nütz :_gamepad_face_button_down:, üm den Giëgenstand optonemmen, de ünner den Cursor is. Wenn dor mehr as een Giëgenstand is, nimmst du all op, or du kannst :_gamepad_face_button_left: bruken, üm bloots de Hälfte optonemmen.

source_string: Tap to select an item. If there is more than one item here this will select them all.
translation: Tipp, üm en Giëgenstand to utwählen. Wenn dor mehr as een Giëgenstand is, wählst du all ut.

source_string: You can place items down again by using :mouse_left_button:. With multiple items on the cursor, use :mouse_left_button: to place them all or :mouse_right_button: to place just one.
translation: Du kannst Giëgenstänne wedder afsette, in dat du :mouse_left_button: bruukst. Mit mehr Giëgenstänne op den Cursor nütz :mouse_left_button:, üm all af to sette, or :mouse_right_button:, üm bloots een af to sette.

source_string: You can place items down again by using :_gamepad_face_button_down:. With multiple items on the cursor, use :_gamepad_face_button_down: to place them all or :_gamepad_face_button_left: to place just one.
translation: Du kannst Giëgenstänne wedder afsette, in dat du :_gamepad_face_button_down: bruukst. Mit mehr Giëgenstänne op den Cursor nütz :_gamepad_face_button_down:, üm all af to sette, or :_gamepad_face_button_left:, üm bloots een af to sette.

source_string: Tap another place in the inventory to move the item.
translation: Tipp en annern Platz in't Inventar, üm den Giëgenstand to bewegen.

source_string: If the item the cursor is over is armor, you can quick move it to the correct armor slot by pressing SHIFT+:mouse_left_button:.
translation: Wenn de Giëgenstand, över den de Cursor is, Rüsten is, kannst du em gau to den richtigen Rüsten-Platz bewegen, in dat du SHIFT+:mouse_left_button: drükst.

source_string: If the item the cursor is over is armor, you can quick move it to the correct armor slot by pressing :_gamepad_face_button_up:.
translation: Wenn de Giëgenstand, över den de Cursor is, Rüsten is, kannst du em gau to den richtigen Rüsten-Platz bewegen, in dat du :_gamepad_face_button_up: drükst.

source_string: To drop an item, pick up the item and put it down outside of the inventory window.
translation: Üm en Giëgenstand fallen to laten, nimm den Giëgenstand op un legg em buten dat Inventar-Finster af.

source_string: To drop an item, pick up the item and press :_gamepad_face_button_up:.
translation: Üm en Giëgenstand fallen to laten, nimm den Giëgenstand op un drük :_gamepad_face_button_up:.

source_string: To drop an item, tap the item and then tap outside of the inventory window.
translation: Üm en Giëgenstand fallen to laten, tipp den Giëgenstand un tipp denn buten dat Inventar-Finster.

source_string: Minecraft is a multiplayer game by default.
You can have local players join your game by connecting controllers and pressing any button on their controller at any point during the game.
translation: Du kannst lokale Speelers to dien Speel tolaten, in dat se Controllers anschluten un jeedwelk Knop op ehr Controller drükt, jeedertiet wielt dat Speel löppt.

source_string: By default, all worlds start with multiplayer enabled. If you would like to make the world private, go to world settings and select the multiplayer option, then toggle multiplayer off.
translation: Standardmäßig fangt all Wiälten mit anschalter Mäerspeelerwise an. Wenn du de Wiält privaat maken wist, gah to de Wiält-Instellen un wähl de Mäerspeelerwise-Optschoon ut, denn schalt de Mäerspeelerwise uut.

source_string: By default, all worlds start with multiplayer enabled. If you would like to make the world private, go to world settings and select the multiplayer option, then toggle multiplayer off.
translation: Standardmäßig fangt all Wiälten mit anschalter Mäerspeelerwise an. Wenn du de Wiält privaat maken wist, gah to de Wiält-Instellen un wähl de Mäerspeelerwise-Optschoon ut, denn schalt de Mäerspeelerwise uut.

source_string: To join a multiplayer game, go to the friends tab. All joinable Realms, Friends, and LAN Games will be shown here. Pick a game and select it to join.
translation: Üm en Mäerspeelerwise-Speel to bedreden, gah to den Fründe-Tab. All bedredbore Realms, Fründe un LAN-Speele warrt hier wiest. Wähl en Speel ut un utwähl dat, üm mittomaken.

source_string: To join a multiplayer game, go to the friends tab. All joinable Realms, Friends, and LAN Games will be shown here. Pick a game and select it to join.
translation: Üm en Mäerspeelerwise-Speel to bedreden, gah to den Fründe-Tab. All bedredbore Realms, Fründe un LAN-Speele warrt hier wiest. Wähl en Speel ut un utwähl dat, üm mittomaken.

source_string: When you start or join an online game, it will be visible to people in your friends tab. Once your friends join, the game will now be visible to friends of these friends.
translation: Wenn du en Online-Speel startst or bedredst, ward dat för Lüüd in dien Fründe-Tab to sehn. Wenn dien Fründe mittomaken, ward dat Speel ok för Fründe vun disse Fründe to sehn.

source_string: Note: You must have an internet connection and be signed into Xbox Live to play multiplayer.
translation: Anmarken: Du musst en Internetverbinnen hebben un bi Xbox Live anmellt sien, üm Mäerspeelerwise to speelen.

source_string: If you would like to manage the permissions of individual players, player permissions makes it easy. Open the pause menu and on the right, you will see a list of players currently in the world. Select their permission icon to adjust that player's permissions.
translation: Wenn du de Verlöve vun enkelte Speelers verwalten wist, mäkt Speeler-Verlöve dat liecht. Apen dat Pausmenü, un rechts sühst du en List vun Speelers, de opstunns in de Wiält sünd. Wähl ehr Verlöv-Icon ut, üm de Verlöve vun den Speeler antopassen.

source_string: Realms is an awesome place to host a multiplayer game that is always running. Even when you aren't playing, your Realm will be up and running for your friends to explore!
translation: Realms is en tolle Oort, üm en Mäerspeelerwise-Speel to gastgäven, dat immer löppt. Ok wenn du nich speelst, löppt dien Realm wieder, so dat dien Fründe dat utfünnigen köönt!

source_string: To set up a Realm, select Create New from the Worlds tab. Then select the New Realm button, then the Create New World button. Here you can name your Realm, and set the number of players. Then you will be able to add friends to your Realm.
translation: Üm en Realm intostellen, wähl Nee maken ut den Wiälten-Tab ut. Denn wähl den Nee-Realm-Knop, denn den Nee-Wiält-maken-Knop. Hier kannst du dien Realm benennen un de Antall vun Speelers fastsette. Denn kannst du Fründe to dien Realm tofögen.

source_string: Once you have a Realm created, select the Pencil button to change the Realm settings.
translation: Wenn du en Realm maakt hest, wähl den Bleistift-Knop, üm de Realm-Instellen to ännern.

source_string: Under the Game button, you can rename the Realm, set the difficulty and gamemode, turn on cheats, and download/upload the world.
translation: Ünner den Speel-Knop kannst du den Realm ümbenennen, de Swoorde un de Speelwise fastsette, Cheats anschalten un de Wiält daal-/hoochladen.

source_string: Under the Members button you can manage all of the friends you've invited to your Realm, add/remove members, and set their permissions.
translation: Ünner den Lüüd-Knop kannst du all Fründe verwalten, de du to dien Realm inlaadt hest, Lüüd tofögen/wegmaken un ehr Verlöve fastsette.

source_string: Under the Subscription button you can see when the Realm will expire, extend the time until expiration, and open/close the Realm.
translation: Ünner den Abonnement-Knop sühst du, wenn dien Realm oplöppt, kannst de Tiet bit to't Oplopen verlängern un den Realm apen/sluten.

source_string: How to Play : Resource And Behavior Packs
translation: Wie speel ik : Matriaol- un Verhollen-Pakätte

source_string: You can change the way that Minecraft looks and behaves using Resource and Behavior Packs.
translation: Du kannst ännern, wie Minecraft utsüht un sik verhöllt, in dat du Matriaol- un Verhollen-Pakätte bruukst.

source_string: In the Settings Menu, choose a pack from the available packs list and select the plus sign next to it. Now your pack will apply its changes to the default Minecraft pack.
translation: In't Instellen-Menü wähl en Pakett ut de List vun verfügboore Pakätte un klick op dat Plus-Tecken dorbi. Nu wendt dien Pakett sien Ännerungen op dat Standard-Minecraft-Pakett an.

source_string: The Server Tab will show popular Minecraft servers.
The Minecraft Marketplace is a place to find new skins, worlds, textures, and mash-up packs by various talented creators.
translation: Dat Minecraft-Marketplace is en Oort, wo du nee Skins, Wiälten, Texturen un Mash-up-Pakätte vun verschedene talenteerte Makers finnen kannst.

source_string: Try a new skin for a fresh new look!
translation: Versöök en nee Skin för en fresh nee Utseen!

source_string: Check out worlds to unlock new maps and challenges that you will want to play again and again!
translation: Kiek Wiälten an, üm nee Kaarten un Utfordrungen freetoschalten, de du immer wedder speelen wist!

source_string: Give your old game a new look with texture packs that can be layered over your current worlds and Realms!
translation: Giff dien oll Speel en nee Utseen mit Texturpakätte, de över dien aktuelle Wiälten un Realms leggt warrn köönt!

source_string: Give your old game a new look with texture packs that can be layered over your current worlds and Realms!
translation: Giff dien oll Speel en nee Utseen mit Texturpakätte, de över dien aktuelle Wiälten un Realms leggt warrn köönt!

source_string: Or try them all with mash-up packs which are curated collections of skins, worlds, and textures that, when combined, will transform your worlds and Realms!
translation: Or versöök all tosamen mit Mash-up-Pakätte, dat sünd utwählte Sammelungen vun Skins, Wiälten un Texturen, de, wenn kombineert, dien Wiälten un Realms verwandelt!

source_string: Or try them all with mash-up packs which are curated collections of skins, worlds, and textures that, when combined, will transform your worlds and Realms!
translation: Or versöök all tosamen mit Mash-up-Pakätte, dat sünd utwählte Sammelungen vun Skins, Wiälten un Texturen, de, wenn kombineert, dien Wiälten un Realms verwandelt!

source_string: Tap the Ride button while near a Minecart to hop in and ride. Press :_input_key.forward: to roll forward. Tap :_input_key.jump: to get out.
translation: Tipp den Rieden-Knop, wenn du bi en Minecart büst, üm intostiegen un to rieden. Drük :_input_key.forward:, üm vörwarts to rullen. Tipp :_input_key.jump:, üm rutokamen.

source_string: Tap the board button while near a Boat to board it. Press :_input_key.left: or :_input_key.right: to turn left or right. Press them both to move forward. Tap the leave boat button to get out.
translation: Tipp den Instiegen-Knop, wenn du bi en Boot büst, üm intostiegen. Drük :_input_key.left: or :_input_key.right:, üm links or rechts to dreien. Drük beid, üm vörwarts to gaon. Tipp den Boot-verlaten-Knop, üm rutokamen.

source_string: The Sword, Bow, and Trident have specific enchantments that you can get from the Enchanting Table or Anvil that will improve damage, durability and even light mobs on fire!
translation: Dat Sweert, de Bogen un de Dreitand hebbt bestimmte Verzauverungen, de du vun de Verzauvertafel or dat Ambeet kriegen kannst, de den Schaden, de Duurhaftigkeid verbetert un ok Wesen in Brand sette künnt!

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Press :_input_key.attack: to attack. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to draw the trident back. Release :_input_key.use: to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: De Dreitand is en Wapen för Naukampf un Fernkampf. Drük :_input_key.attack:, üm antogriepen. Drük un hool :_input_key.use: fast, üm den Dreitand torüchtotrecken. Laat :_input_key.use: loos, üm den Dreitand to smieten. De Dreitand is dat beste Wapen unner Water.

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Tap mobs to attack them. Press and hold the Screen to draw the trident back. Release the press to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: De Dreitand is en Wapen för Naukampf un Fernkampf. Tipp Wesen an, üm se antogriepen. Drük un hool den Scherm fast, üm den Dreitand torüchtotrecken. Laat losdrücken, üm den Dreitand to smieten. De Dreitand is dat beste Wapen unner Water.

source_string: %s has changed from %s skin to %s skin.

Want to broadcast your game? You need to have a compatible broadcasting app installed. We recommend Mixer Create as it allows you to broadcast with sub-second latency, co-stream with friends and lets your viewers interact in fun ways. Certain features like Chat and Viewer Count only work with Mixer Create.
translation: Wist du dien Speel utsennen? Du brükst en passende Utsenn-App installeert. Wi raodt Mixer Create an, dor kannst du mit under-Sekunn-Latenz utsennen, tosamen mit Fründe streamen, un dien Kiekers köönt op fründliche Wiesen mitmaken. Enkelte Funkschonen as Chat un Kieker-Tall funkscheneert bloots mit Mixer Create.

source_string: You do not have permission to use this feature. Please go to xbox.com and sign in to your account to fix this
translation: Du hest keen Verlöv, disse Funkschoon to bruken. Gah bitte to xbox.com un meld di bi dien Account an, üm dat to fixen

source_string: We need you to sign in before you can start broadcasting your game.
translation: Wi brükt, dat du di anmellst, ehr du dien Speel uttsennen kannst.

source_string: Xforge Requests Wait for Sign In
This world has Behavior Packs applied to it that you must download to join. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Disse Wiält hett Verhollenpakätte, de du daalladen musst, üm mittomaken. Wist du se daalladen un mittomaken?

source_string: This world has Behavior Packs applied to it that you must download to join and Resource Packs that you may optionally download before joining. What would you like to download before joining?
translation: Disse Wiält hett Verhollenpakätte, de du daalladen musst, üm mittomaken, un Matriaolpakätte, de du optschonaal daalladen kannst, ehr du mittomaakst. Wat wist du daalladen, ehr du mittomaakst?

source_string: This world has Behavior and Resource Packs applied to it that you must download to join. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Disse Wiält hett Verhollen- un Matriaolpakätte, de du daalladen musst, üm mittomaken. Wist du se daalladen un mittomaken?

source_string: This world has Resource Packs applied to it. Would you like to download them before you join?
translation: Disse Wiält hett Matriaolpakätte. Wist du se daalladen, ehr du mittomaakst?

source_string: This world has Resource Packs applied to it that you must download to join. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Disse Wiält hett Matriaolpakätte, de du daalladen musst, üm mittomaken. Wist du se daalladen un mittomaken?

source_string: Adding or removing Behavior Packs after playing a world might break the world and cause you to lose what you created.
translation: Verhollenpakätte tofögen or wegmaken, na dat du en Wiält speelt hest, kann de Wiält kaputt maken un dorto föhren, dat du dien Schöpungen verlüst.

source_string: Removing Behavior Packs with a plugin might break the world and cause you to lose what you created.
translation: Verhollenpakätte mit en Plugin wegmaken kann de Wiält kaputt maken un dorto föhren, dat du dien Schöpungen verlüst.

source_string: This resolution is incompatible with your device because your device doesn't have enough memory.
translation: Disse Oplösung is nich kompatibel mit dien Gerät, wielt dien Gerät nich noog Spieker hett.

source_string: This pack is incompatible with your device because it doesn't have enough memory.
translation: Disse Pakett is nich kompatibel mit dien Gerät, wielt dat nich noog Spieker hett.

source_string: Unlock all %s Skins, Texture Pack, and World for %s:minecoin:
translation: All %s Skins, Texturpakett un Wiält för %s:minecoin: freeschalten

source_string: Tell the creator and the community about your experience with this item!
translation: Vertell den Maker un de Gemeenschaop, wie dien Utenanner mit düssem Giëgenstand weer!

source_string: Before we can let you rate an item, you will need to sign in with Xbox Live.
translation: Ehr wi di en Giëgenstand bewerten laoten könnt, musst du di mit Xbox Live anmellen.

source_string: Write a description of your structure.
translation: Schriev en Beschrieven vun dien Bauwiärk.

source_string: Your awesome creation has been uploaded to Remix3D.com using your Remix 3D profile. You can update your profile name and image on Remix3D.com anytime.
translation: Dien tolle Schöpung is na Remix3D.com hoochladen worrn, mit dien Remix 3D-Profil. Du kannst dien Profil-Naam un -Bild jeedertiet op Remix3D.com aktualiseren.

source_string: New! Your Remix 3D profile is no longer linked to your Xbox Live gamertag. If you’ve already got a Remix 3D profile, we reserved your current gamertag as your name. If you’re new, we will autogenerate a Remix 3D profile for you. (You can edit it later on Remix3D.com.) Hit Agree to acknowledge this change and upload your creation to Remix3D.com. Microsoft Services Agreement and Privacy Statements apply.
translation: Nee! Dien Remix 3D-Profil is nich mehr mit dien Xbox Live-Gamertag verbunnen. Wenn du all en Remix 3D-Profil hest, hebbt wi dien aktuellen Gamertag as dien Naam reserveert. Wenn du nee büst, generert wi automaatsch en Remix 3D-Profil för di. (Du kannst dat later op Remix3D.com bearbeiden.) Drük Akkoord, üm disse Ännerung antonehmen un dien Schöpung na Remix3D.com hoochtoladen. De Microsoft-Deenstverdrag un -Datenschutz-Erklärungen gellt.

source_string: You must be signed in to Xbox Live to upload to Remix3D.com.
translation: Du musst bi Xbox Live anmellt sien, üm na Remix3D.com hoochtoladen.

source_string: Oh no! You don't have permission to join Remix3D.com.
translation: Oh nee! Du hest keen Verlöv, Remix3D.com bitotreden.

source_string: Uh oh! Your model is too large. Please try uploading a smaller file.
translation: Oh nee! Dien Modell is to groot. Versöök bitte, en kleener Datei hochtoladen.

source_string: Oops! Your model failed to upload to Remix3D.com.
translation: Huups! Dien Modell kunn nich na Remix3D.com hoochladen warrn.

source_string: Something went wrong. We weren't able to convert your world. You can send us your world later by going to your old world and pressing Y. Or send us your world now so we can investigate further.
translation: Dor is wat schiefgahn. Wi kunnen dien Wiält nich ümwannel. Du kannst uns dien Wiält later schicken, in dat du to dien oll Wiält gaost un Y drükst. Or schick uns dien Wiält nu, so dat wi wieder ünnersöken könnt.
Wesen bedreegen sik leeg or fehlten

source_string: Lost my items, creations, and/or player stats
translation: Ik hebb mien Giëgenstänne, Schöpungen un/or Speeler-Statistiken verloren

source_string: By hitting Agree, you are uploading your world to the Minecraft Team. The Microsoft Services Agreement and Privacy Statement apply.
translation: In dat du Akkoord drükst, laadst du dien Wiält na dat Minecraft-Team hooch. De Microsoft-Deenstverdrag un -Datenschutz-Erklärung gellt.

source_string: By uploading your World you hereby authorize Microsoft to test, reproduce, modify, distribute and publicly display your World in support of transferring your World to Minecraft.
translation: In dat du dien Wiält hoochladst, erlöövst du Microsoft, dien Wiält to testen, to reproduzeren, to ännern, to verdelen un öffentlich to wiesen, üm dien Wiält na Minecraft to övertragen.
Oll Wiält ward na Minecraft schickt...

source_string: Thank you! We are hard at work fixing things and won't be able to get back to you about this specific world. Here's your receipt confirming that we received it:
translation: Dank di! Wi arbeidt hart doran, Dinge to fixen, un köönt di nich to disse enkelte Wiält antworden. Hier is dien Quittung, de bestätigt, dat wi dat kregen hebbt:

source_string: It appears you don't have a license for Minecraft. Make sure you have downloaded and installed Minecraft from the store
translation: Dat süht so ut, as wenn du keen Lizenz för Minecraft hest. Kiek na, dat du Minecraft ut de Buutick daalladen un installeert hest

source_string: When you see this icon, we are saving your game. Do not turn off your Nintendo Switch while this icon is on screen.
translation: Wenn du disse Icon sühst, spiekert wi dien Speel. Schalt dien Nintendo Switch nich uut, wielt disse Icon op'n Scherm is.

source_string: Xbox Live has arrived in Minecraft! It's a gaming community for phones, PCs, and Xbox. And the best part?
translation: Xbox Live is in Minecraft ankamen! Dat is en Speelgemeenschaop för Telefone, PCs un Xbox. Un dat Beste?

source_string: Don't have a Gamertag? Create one to earn achievements, play online with friends and join Realms!
translation: Hest du keen Gamertag? Maak een, üm Erfolge to verdenen, online mit Fründe to speelen un Realms bitotreden!

source_string: Don't have a Gamertag? Create one to earn achievements, play online with friends and join Realms!
translation: Hest du keen Gamertag? Maak een, üm Erfolge to verdenen, online mit Fründe to speelen un Realms bitotreden!

source_string: We tried to sign you in to your Xbox Live account, but something went wrong.
translation: Wi hebbt versöcht, di bi dien Xbox Live-Account antomellen, aver dor is wat schiefgahn.

source_string: If you play without signing in you won't be able to see your friends list, earn achievements, join Realms, or play online on Xbox Live.
translation: Wenn du speelst, ahn di antomellen, kannst du dien Fründe-List nich sehn, keen Erfolge verdenen, keen Realms bitotreden or online op Xbox Live speelen.

source_string: Achievements and Gamerscore mark your progress through Minecraft.
translation: Erfolge un Gamerscore markeert dien Vörankamen dörch Minecraft.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start earning them!
translation: Meld di bi Xbox Live an, üm anfangen to könen, se to verdenen!

source_string: Add a friend to see when they are online and to play online multiplayer without the hassle of IP addresses and ports.
translation: Föög en Fründ to, üm to sehn, wenn he online is, un üm Online-Mäerspeelerwise to speelen, ahn de Möh mit IP-Adressen un Ports.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start adding friends!
translation: Meld di bi Xbox Live an, üm anfangen to könen, Fründe tofögen!

source_string: Invite your friends to play online multiplayer with you without the hassle of IP address and ports.
translation: Laad dien Fründe in, üm Online-Mäerspeelerwise mit di to speelen, ahn de Möh mit IP-Adressen un Ports.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start inviting friends!
translation: Meld di bi Xbox Live an, üm anfangen to könen, Fründe intoladen!

source_string: Servers offer some of the most creative ways to play Minecraft! We just need you to sign in so that we can make sure you have permission to play online with new people.
translation: Servers bedeet en Deel vun de mehrst kreativen Wiesen, Minecraft to speelen! Wi brükt bloots, dat du di anmellst, so dat wi seker gaon köönt, dat du Verlöv hest, online mit neen Lüüd to speelen.

source_string: Thank you for sending us a copy of your world and helping us find bugs! We are hard at work fixing things and won't be able to get back to you about this specific world. Here's your receipt confirming that we received it: %s
translation: Dank di, dat du uns en Kopie vun dien Wiält schickt un uns hulpen hest, Fehler to finnen! Wi arbeidt hart doran, Dinge to fixen, un köönt di nich to disse enkelte Wiält antworden. Hier is dien Quittung, de bestätigt, dat wi dat kregen hebbt: %s

source_string: Oops! We weren't able to receive your world. Try checking your internet connection or sending it again later.
translation: Huups! Wi kunnen dien Wiält nich kriegen. Kiek dien Internetverbinnen na or schick dat later nochmaol.

source_string: Did your old world not look or work the way it should have? Send us your world and help us find the bugs!
translation: Sach dien oll Wiält nich richtig ut or funkscheneert nich, wie se schull? Schick uns dien Wiält un hölp uns, de Fehler to finnen!

source_string: You can change the look of your character with a Skin Pack from the Store. Select 'Store' on the Main Menu to see what's available.
translation: Du kannst dat Utseen vun dien Figur mit en Skinpakett ut de Buutick ännern. Wähl „Buutick“ in't Hööftmenü ut, üm to sehn, wat verfügboor is.

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
Alter the brightness setting to make the game brighter or darker.
translation: Änner de Helligkeid-Instellen, üm dat Speel heller or düsterer to maken.

source_string: If you set the game difficulty to Peaceful, your health will automatically regenerate, and no monsters will come out at night!
translation: Wenn du de Speel-Swoorde op Freedig sett, regenereert sik dien Gesundheid automaatsch, un keen Monster kaamt nachts rut!

source_string: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Giff en Wulf en Knoken, üm em to tamen. Denn kannst du em sitten laten or di folgen laten.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: Wenn du en Kürbis op'n Kopp dröögst, greept Endermen di nich an.

source_string: Sleeping in a bed at night will fast forward the game to dawn, but all players in a multiplayer game need to sleep in beds at the same time.
translation: Wenn du nachts in en Bett sliäpst, springt dat Speel to den Morgen, aver all Speelers in en Mäerspeelerwise-Speel möt gliektiet sliäpen.

source_string: Harvest food from pigs, cows, sheep, rabbit, and chickens. Cook and eat it to regain health!
translation: Sammel Eten vun Swien, Köh, Schaop, Kaniën un Höhner. Koken un eet dat, üm Gesundheid wedder to kriegen!

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Sammel Läder vun Köh un nütz dat, üm Rüsten un Boker to maken.

source_string: If you have an empty bucket, you can fill it with water, lava, or milk from a cow!
translation: Wenn du en leegen Kübel hest, kannst du em mit Water, Lava, or Melk vun en Kau füllen!

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Nütz en Hakke, üm Gebeeten Grund för't Planten vörbereden.

source_string: Spiders won't attack you during the day - unless you attack them.
translation: Spinnen greept di dags nich an - butter, wenn du se antgriepst.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: En Deer to fooden höllt dat dorvun af, to verswinnen. Boe en Zaun, üm dien Deere sicher to hollen.

source_string: Eating cooked food reduces hunger better than eating raw food.
translation: Kookt Eten to eten senkt den Hunger beter as rohes Eten.

source_string: Craft torches to light up dark areas. Monsters lurk in the darkness!
translation: Wiärk Lunte, üm düstere Gebeeten to belüchten. Monster lurkt in de Düsternis!

source_string: Get to destinations faster with a minecart and rail!
translation: Kumm gauer to Zielen mit en Minecart un Rail!

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Plant en paar Setlinge un se wasst to Bomen.

source_string: Pigmen won't attack you - unless you attack them.
translation: Swienmänner greept di nich an - butter, wenn du se antgriepst.

source_string: You can change your game spawn point, and skip to dawn by sleeping in a bed.
translation: Du kannst dien Spawn-Punkt ännern un to den Morgen springen, in dat du in en Bett sliäpst.

source_string: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
translation: Sla de Füerballen torüch na den Ghast!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension - The Nether.
translation: En Portal to boen lett di na en anner Dimensioon reisen - The Nether.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Digging dirt with a shovel is much faster than using a pickaxe!
translation: Nütz dat richtige Wiärktüüg för de Opgaov! Eer graven mit en Schüffel is veel gauer as mit en Piekhau!

source_string: If you can't find any coal for your torches, you can always make charcoal from trees in a furnace.
translation: Wenn du keen Kool för dien Lunte findst, kannst du immer Holtkool ut Bomen in en Backaoven maken.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up is not a great idea.
translation: Grad daal or grad hooch graven is keen gute Idee.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a Skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: Knokenmehl (maakt ut en Skelett-Knoken) kann as Dünger bruukt warrn un lett Dinge fastens wasse!

source_string: Creepers explode when they get close to you!
translation: Creepers explodeert, wenn se di nah kaamt!

source_string: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Obsidian ward maakt, wenn Water op en Lava-Quellblock treffet.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: Wenn de Quellblock för Water or Lava wegmaakt ward, höllt de Fluss heel op.

source_string: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
translation: Kopperstein is resistent gegen Ghast-Füerballen, dat mäkt em nütslich för't Bewachen vun Portale.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice. This includes torches, glowstones, and Jack-O-Lanterns.
translation: Blöcke, de as Lechtquelle bruukt warrt, smelten Snee un Ies. Dorto hoort Lunte, Glowstones un Jack-O-Lanternen.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Pass op, wenn du Bauwiärke ut Wulle buten boest, wielt Blitze vun Gewitter Wulle in Brand setten könnt.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: En enkelten Kübel Lava kann in en Backaoven bruukt warrn, üm 100 Blöcke to smeltn.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: Dat Instrument, dat en Musikblok speelt, hangt vun't Matriaol dorünner af.

source_string: Zombies and Skeletons can survive daylight if they are in water or wearing a helmet.
translation: Zombies un Skeletten köönt Dagslecht överleven, wenn se in't Water sünd or en Helm draogt.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves in the immediate vicinity to turn hostile and attack you. This trait is also shared by Zombie Pigmen.
translation: En Wulf antogriepen mäkt jeed Wulf in de Nähe fiendlich un he greept di an. Disse Egenschap deelt ok Zombie-Swienmänner.

source_string: Wolves and Iron Golems won't attack Creepers.
translation: Wülfe un Iesengolems greept Creepers nich an.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: Höhner leggt all 5 to 10 Minüten en Egg.

source_string: Obsidian can only be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Obsidian kann bloots mit en Diamant-Piekhau graven warrn.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: Creepers sünd de eenfachste Quelle för Schießpulver.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: Twee Kisten nabenanner to sette mäkt een grote Kist.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: Tamete Wülfe wiest ehr Gesundheid dör de Positschoon vun ehr Steert. Giff ehr Fleesch, üm se to betern.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Verschedene Farvstoffe köönt ut mennig Matriaolen maakt warrn, kook Kaktus in en Backaoven, üm gröönen Farvstoff to kriegen!

source_string: On mobile devices, you can download the "Music by Minecraft" pack from the Music Category in the Minecraft Store.
translation: Op mobile Geräte kannst du dat „Music by Minecraft“-Pakett ut de Musik-Kategorie in de Minecraft-Buutick daalladen.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: En Deel Deere folgt di, wenn du Weiten in de Hand hollst.

source_string: There will be an update to this game eventually!
translation: Dat warrt irgendwann en Update för dit Speel geven!

source_string: Mojang has more awards than staff!
translation: Mojang hett mehr Pries as Mitarbeiders!

source_string: Do not look directly at the bugs.
translation: Kiek nich direkt op de Fehler.

source_string: Creepers were born from a coding bug.
translation: Creepers sünd ut en Programmeerfehler entstaan.

source_string: Is it a chicken or is it a duck?
translation: Is dat en Hoon oder en Aant?

source_string: No-one at Mojang has ever seen Junkboy's face.
translation: Keeneen bi Mojang hett Junkboy sien Gesicht je sehn.

source_string: Did you know there's a Minecraft Wiki?
translation: Wüsst du, dat dat en Minecraft-Wiki gifft?

source_string: MINECON 2011 was in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA!
translation: MINECON 2011 weer in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA!

source_string: MINECON 2013 was in Orlando, Florida, USA!
translation: MINECON 2013 weer in Orlando, Florida, USA!

source_string: No-one can remember where MINECON 2014 was held.
translation: Keeneen kann sik erinnern, wo MINECON 2014 weer.

source_string: MINECON 2016 was in Anaheim, California, USA!
translation: MINECON 2016 weer in Anaheim, California, USA!

source_string: Always assume rumors are false, rather than assuming they're true!
translation: Nimm jümmers an, Klönschnack is falsch, ne dat he woor is!

source_string: The first version of Minecraft was created in just 6 days!
translation: De eerste Verschoon vun Minecraft wöör in bloots 6 Daag maakt!

source_string: The Enderman language is actually English in reverse.
translation: De Spraak vun de Enderman is eegentlich Engelsch verkehrtrüm.

source_string: The original name for Minecraft was Cave Game.
translation: De originaale Naam för Minecraft weer Cave Game.

source_string: Pigs that are struck by lightning become Zombie Pigmen!
translation: Swien, de vun'n Blitz drapen ward, warrt Zombie-Swienminschen!

source_string: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager children!
translation: Mennigmaal geevt Iesgolems Blomen an de Dörpkinner!

source_string: A Spider Jockey is the rare appearance of a spider being ridden by a skeleton!
translation: En Spinnenjockey is dat sülten Vörkomen vun en Spinn, de vun en Skelett bereden warrt!

source_string: Traveling one block in the Nether is equal to traveling eight blocks in the overworld.
translation: Een Blok in'n Nether to reisen is dat Sülvige as acht Blök in de Oewerwiält to reisen.

source_string: You need an Agent to code! Get an Agent egg from your creative inventory.
translation: Du bruukst en Agent, üm to koden! Hool di en Agent-Ai ut dien Kreativ-Taske.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to sync your Skins, Texture Packs, Worlds, and Mash-ups. They will be there for you on any device where you play Minecraft.
translation: Mell di bi Xbox Live an, üm dien Skins, Texturenpackete, Wiälten un Mash-ups to synchroneseren. Se sünd denn dor för di op jedwedes Gerät, wo du Minecraft speelst.

source_string: Syncing purchases to Xbox Live account...
translation: Köpe warrt mit Xbox Live-Konto synchroneseert...

source_string: This Xbox Live account will not be the primary account for this device if you do not sync this device's purchases to this account. You will not automatically sign in when you start Minecraft.
translation: Dit Xbox Live-Konto warrt nich dat Hööftkonto för dit Gerät, wenn du de Köpe vun dit Gerät nich mit dit Konto synchroneserst. Du warrst nich automaatsch anmellt, wenn du Minecraft startst.

source_string: Your app store purchases will be available wherever you log in with %s. You can only sync these packs to one account, but they will continue to be available to anyone who uses this device.
translation: Dien Köpe ut'n App-Store sünd verfüügbaar, woneemer du di mit %s anmellst. Du kannst disse Pakete bloots mit een Konto synchroneseren, man se blifft för all verfüügbaar, de dit Gerät bruukt.

source_string: Is this the account that you would like to use to access your previous purchases?
translation: Is dit dat Konto, mit dat du op dien vörige Köpe togriepen wullt?

source_string: You can't extend your Realm right now. We have now introduced subscriptions for Realms on Xbox and you can buy a new subscription as soon as your Realm has expired in %d days. But don't worry! We will give you 14 extra days for free and your Realm will be kept online, so you will have plenty of time to extend it by then.
translation: Du kannst dien Realm nu nich verlängern. Wi hebbt nu Abos för Realms op Xbox indräpen, un du kannst en nee Abo köpen, so bold dien Realm in %d Daag afloopen is. Man kien Bang! Wi geevt di 14 Extra-Daag gratis, un dien Realm blifft online, so hest du noog Tiet, ehr du dat verlängerst.

source_string: How to Play : Education Edition Blocks
Minecraft: Education Edition features several special blocks that make it easier for teachers to create and employ lessons. World Builder ability negates the restrictions of these blocks.
translation: Minecraft: Education Edition hett en Reeg Sünnerblök, de Lehrers dat lichter maakt, Lektschoonen to bauen un to bruken. De Wiältbauer-Fähigkeit hebbt dat Riecht, de Ingrenzen vun disse Blök to negeern.

source_string: Allow and Deny blocks focus where players can build in a world.
translation: Verlöven- un Verbeeden-Blök leggt fast, wo Speelers in en Wiält bauen köönt.

source_string: Allow blocks let players place or destroy blocks in the area above them.
translation: Verlöven-Blök laat Speelers Blök in dat Gebeed baven ehr setten oder afbreken.

source_string: Deny blocks prohibit users from placing or destroying blocks in the area above them.
translation: Verbeeden-Blök verbeedt Bruukers, in dat Gebeed baven ehr Blök to setten oder to afbreken.

source_string: Neither block affects the area below them.
translation: Kien vun de beiden Blök wirkt op dat Gebeed nerrn ehr.

source_string: If an Allow block is placed somewhere with a Deny block below it, the space between the two blocks will be protected while the space above the Allow block will permit users to place and destroy blocks.
translation: Wenn en Verlöven-Blok ünner sik en Verbeeden-Blok hett, warrt de Ruum twüschen de beiden Blök schützt, wielt de Ruum baven den Verlöven-Blok Bruukers dat Setten un Afbreken vun Blök verlöövt.

source_string: Border Blocks are bright, red walls that act like a force field, extending upwards and downwards forever!
translation: Grenzblök sünd hell rode Müern, de as en Kraftfeld wirkt un endlos rup un daal geet!

source_string: Border blocks prevent players from passing through, over, or under them by any means other than being a World Builder.
translation: Grenzblök hollt Speelers dorvun af, dör, oewer oder ünner ehr to gaan – nix as en Wiältbauer to sien hölpt dor gegen.

source_string: Border blocks cannot be destroyed by non-World Builders.
translation: Grenzblök köönt vun Nich-Wiältbauern nich afbraken warrn.

source_string: Structure blocks save existing structures so they can be loaded in a different spot or even exported for later use.
translation: Bauwiärksblök sekert bestahn Bauwiärken, so dat se an en annern Stee laden oder sogaar för later exporteert warrn köönt.

source_string: NPCs display their dialog text when interacted with by non-World Builders.
translation: NPCs wiest ehr Dialogtext, wenn Nich-Wiältbauern mit ehr interageert.

source_string: NPCs can also launch external URLs or execute commands automatically on closing their dialog box, or by assigning actions to buttons for players to interact with. All automatic commands (and URLs) are executed in the order they are added to the NPC.
translation: NPCs köönt ok extern URLs starten oder Befehle automaatsch utföhren, wenn ehr Dialogfeld tomaakt warrt, oder wenn Speelers Knööp mit Akschonen togewiest kriegt. All automaatsch Befehle (un URLs) warrt in de Ordnung utföhrt, in de se an den NPC toföögt wöörn.

source_string: Once placed, face the Camera and press the on-screen button labeled "Take Picture".
translation: Wenn de Kamera sett is, kiek to ehr un drük den Knoop op den Schirm, de "Bild maken" heet.

source_string: The Camera will track you during this time, doing its best to keep you in the shot, even if you move around.
translation: De Kamera folgt di in disse Tiet un versöcht, di in dat Bild to hollen, ok wenn du di bewegst.

source_string: After the five second timer counts down, your picture is taken.
translation: Na den Countdown vun fief Sekunnen warrt dien Bild maakt.

source_string: Pictures can be viewed in the Portfolio or inserted into a book using the Book & Quill.
translation: Bilder köönt in dat Portfolio bekeken oder mit dat Book & Fedder in en Book infoögt warrn.

source_string: You can caption your pictures by pressing :mouse_left_button: on the caption label.
translation: Du kannst dien Bilder mit en Ünnerschrift versehn, wenn du :mouse_left_button: op dat Ünnerschriftfeld drükst.

source_string: You can caption your pictures by selecting the caption label and pressing :_gamepad_face_button_down: .
translation: Du kannst dien Bilder mit en Ünnerschrift versehn, wenn du dat Ünnerschriftfeld utwählst un :_gamepad_face_button_down: drükst.

source_string: You can caption your pictures by tapping the caption label.
translation: Du kannst dien Bilder mit en Ünnerschrift versehn, wenn du op dat Ünnerschriftfeld tippst.

source_string: You can delete your pictures by pressing :mouse_left_button: on the trash icon below the picture.
translation: Du kannst dien Bilder löschen, wenn du :mouse_left_button: op dat Papierkorf-Teken ünner dat Bild drükst.

source_string: You can delete your pictures by selecting the trash icon below the picture and pressing :_gamepad_face_button_down: .
translation: Du kannst dien Bilder löschen, wenn du dat Papierkorf-Teken ünner dat Bild utwählst un :_gamepad_face_button_down: drükst.

source_string: You can delete your pictures by tapping the trash icon below the picture.
translation: Du kannst dien Bilder löschen, wenn du op dat Papierkorf-Teken ünner dat Bild tippst.

source_string: You can export your Portfolio as a series of images by pressing :mouse_left_button: on the Export Portfolio button.
translation: Du kannst dien Portfolio as en Reeg Bilder exporteren, wenn du :mouse_left_button: op den Knoop "Portfolio exporteren" drükst.

source_string: You can export your Portfolio as a series of images by selecting the Export Portfolio button and pressing :_gamepad_face_button_down: .
translation: Du kannst dien Portfolio as en Reeg Bilder exporteren, wenn du den Knoop "Portfolio exporteren" utwählst un :_gamepad_face_button_down: drükst.

source_string: You can export your Portfolio as a series of images by tapping the Export Portfolio button.
translation: Du kannst dien Portfolio as en Reeg Bilder exporteren, wenn du op den Knoop "Portfolio exporteren" tippst.

source_string: Code Connection is an extension that allows educators and students to explore, create, and play in an immersive Minecraft world... all by writing code!
translation: Code Connection is en Erwieterung, mit de Lehrers un Schölers in en indrängen Minecraft-Wiält utforschen, opbouen un dor speelen köönt... allens dör Code to schrieven!

source_string: You can launch Code Connection using the command "/code" to get started.
translation: Du kannst Code Connection mit den Befehl "/code" starten, üm los to gaan.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing the :touch_jump: button. If you want to travel downward you can press the :touch_fly_down: button.
translation: Gerüst hölpt di, grote Bauwiärken sicher to bauen! Du kannst binnen dat Gerüst gaan un dorop stahn. Wenn du en Süül vun Gerüst hest, kannst du hoochgaan, wenn du in dat Gerüst steest un den Knoop :touch_jump: drükst. Wenn du daalgaan wullt, kannst du den Knoop :touch_fly_down: drükken.

source_string: We're unable to connect to the library. Maybe check your internet connection?
translation: Wi köönt nich mit de Bibliothek Verbinnen upnehmen. Kiek villicht na dien Internetverbinnen?

source_string: This will save and quit your current game and any multiplayer connections, are you sure you want to quit?
translation: Dit sekert un beennt dien aktuelle Speel un all Mäerspeeler-Verbinnen, wullt du wiss dat afbreken?

source_string: Sorry, we weren't able to find that item in the Library.
translation: Deit us leed, wi köönt dat nich in de Bibliothek finden.

source_string: Welcome to the Minecraft: Education Edition Library!
translation: Willkomen bi de Minecraft: Education Edition-Bibliothek!

source_string: The Library is a new feature we've created to make it easy for teachers and students to find and import educational content directly in the game. In this release, you'll find a list of some of our most popular worlds to import and use, along with a link to the full world library on our website.
translation: De Bibliothek is en nee Funkschoon, de wi maakt hebbt, so dat Lehrers un Schölers licht Bildungsinholt direkt in dat Speel finnen un importeren köönt. In disse Verschoon findst du en List vun sommige vun de beleevtesten Wiälten, de du importeren un bruken kannst, tosamen mit en Link to de vulle Wiält-Bibliothek op uns Websteed.

source_string: We're working on adding support for more types of content and functionality in the coming months. Please let us know what you think by clicking the feedback button.
translation: Wi arbeit dor an, in de kamen Maanden mehr Aarden vun Inholt un Funkschoonen to ünnerstütten. Segg us bitte, wat du dorvun deenst, wenn du op den Rückmell-Knoop drükst.

source_string: Preparing to import new world. This could take a few minutes.
translation: Bereedt nee Wiält vör, üm to importeren. Dat kann en poor Minuten duern.

source_string: with field in rawtext must contain a array. Example: "rawtext":[{"translate": "chat.type.announcement", "with": [ "value1", "value2" ]}]
translation: dat Feld "with" in rawtext mutt en Array wesen. Bispill: "rawtext":[{"translate": "chat.type.announcement", "with": [ "value1", "value2" ]}]

source_string: The world you are trying to enter requires your device to run scripts.  Your device doesn't support scripting at this time, so you can't join from this device.
translation: De Wiält, na de du gaan wullt, verlangt, dat dien Gerät Scripts utföhrt. Dien Gerät ünnerstütt dat Scripten nu nich, so kannst du nich vun dit Gerät bitreden.

source_string: Press W, A, S, or D to move
translation: Drük W, A, S oder D, üm to bewegen
Drük de Leertast, üm to springen

source_string: Tap the right button to jump
translation: Tipp den rechten Knoop, üm to springen

source_string: Press W and space at the same time to jump up onto a block
translation: Drük W un de Leertast to glieker Tiet, üm op en Blok to springen

source_string: Touch the up arrow and the right button at the same time to jump up onto a block
translation: Beröer den Pieltast un den rechten Knoop to glieker Tiet, üm op en Blok to springen

source_string: Move the left stick up and press A at the same time to jump up onto a block
translation: Beweeg den linken Stick nah baven un drük A to glieker Tiet, üm op en Blok to springen

source_string: Find a tree to gather wood
translation: Finn en Boom, üm Holt to sammeln

source_string: Left click and hold to collect 3 pieces of wood
translation: Drük un hool de lenke Muustast, üm 3 Stücken Holt to sammeln

source_string: Tap and hold to collect 3 pieces of wood
translation: Tipp un hool, üm 3 Stücken Holt to sammeln

source_string: Hold down right trigger to collect 3 pieces of wood
translation: Hool den rechten Trigger daal, üm 3 Stücken Holt to sammeln

source_string: Have an idea to improve Minecraft? Find a bug that you want fixed? Or encounter an issue you need help with?  Let us know!
translation: Hest du en Idee, üm Minecraft to verbeteren? Hest du en Fehler funnen, den du reparieert weeten wullt? Oder hest du en Problem, bi dat du Hülp bruukst? Segg us Bescheed!

source_string: Visit this website on another device. https://aka.ms/minecraftfb
translation: Bekiek disse Websteed op en anner Gerät. https://aka.ms/minecraftfb

source_string: Visit this website on another device. https://aka.ms/mcbugs
translation: Bekiek disse Websteed op en anner Gerät. https://aka.ms/mcbugs

source_string: Visit this website on another device. https://aka.ms/helpMC
translation: Bekiek disse Websteed op en anner Gerät. https://aka.ms/helpMC

source_string: The world you are about to enter contains scripts that run on your device. Would you like to join this world?
translation: De Wiält, na de du gaan wullt, hett Scripts, de op dien Gerät loopt. Wullt du bi disse Wiält bitreden?

source_string: Gold is more abundant in Mesa biomes!
translation: Gold gifft dat mehr in Mesa-Biome!

source_string: Diorite, you either love it or hate it.
translation: Diorit, du hoost oder dust dat leev.
Sprint in't Water, üm to swemmen!

source_string: Riptide enchantment will propel you through the air in the rain.
translation: De Verhexung Strömungssoog stöött di dör de Luft, wenn dat regnen deit.

source_string: MINECON Earth is a worldwide interactive live-streaming event. Grab your items and join the party!
translation: MINECON Earth is en wiäldwiet interaktiv Live-Stream-Evenement. Griep dien Sachen un maak mit!

source_string: The Beacon is a powerful item that can only be crafted with a nether star from the Wither!
translation: De Baken is en mächtig Deel, dat bloots mit en Netherstern vun'n Wither maakt warrn kann!
Bring keen Delfin üm, du Monster!

source_string: Did you know that nether stars can't be destroyed by explosions?
translation: Wüsst du, dat Netherstern nich vun Explosjonen kaputtmaakt warrn köönt?

source_string: When digging straight up, place a torch at your feet to break any sand or gravel that could potentially fall down on you.
translation: Wenn du strack rup graafst, sett en Fackel bi dien Föte, üm Sand oder Kies to brecken, de sünst op di daalfallen kunn.

source_string: Attempts to connect to the websocket server to send a video stream.
translation: Versöcht, mit den Websocket-Server to verbinnen, üm en Video-Stream to senden.
Föhrt en Akschoon ut, de mit Videostream to doon hett.

source_string: Walk over items to pick them up
translation: Gah oewer Sachen, üm se optonehmen

source_string: Press E to open your inventory
translation: Drük E, üm dien Taske to apen

source_string: Tap the ... button to open your inventory
translation: Tipp den ...-Knoop, üm dien Taske to apen

source_string: Press Y to open your inventory
translation: Drük Y, üm dien Taske to apen

source_string: Left click to select the wood, then left click in the crafting grid
translation: Klick lenks, üm dat Holt to utwählen, denn klick lenks in't Bauraster

source_string: Tap to select the wood, then tap in the crafting grid
translation: Tipp, üm dat Holt to utwählen, denn tipp in't Bauraster

source_string: Press A to select the wood, then use the left joystick to select the crafting grid
translation: Drük A, üm dat Holt to utwählen, denn bruuk den linken Joystick, üm dat Bauraster to utwählen

source_string: Left click on the output slot to craft the item and add it to your inventory
translation: Klick lenks op de Utgaav-Slot, üm dat Deel to bauen un in dien Taske to leggen

source_string: Tap on the output slot to craft the item and add it to your inventory
translation: Tipp op de Utgaav-Slot, üm dat Deel to bauen un in dien Taske to leggen

source_string: Press A on the output slot to craft the item and add it to your inventory
translation: Drük A op de Utgaav-Slot, üm dat Deel to bauen un in dien Taske to leggen

source_string: Continue to craft until you have 12 planks
translation: Maak wieder, bit du 12 Brettels hest

source_string: Open the recipe book to learn how to craft more things
translation: Apen dat Rezeptbook, üm mehr to leren, wat du bauen kannst

source_string: Press E or left click the X to close the inventory
translation: Drük E oder klick lenks op dat X, üm de Taske tomaken

source_string: Tap the X to close the inventory
translation: Tipp op dat X, üm de Taske tomaken

source_string: Press B to close the inventory
translation: Drük B, üm de Taske tomaken

source_string: The Shield will block incoming damage. The Shield can be equipped in the offhand slot as well as the hotbar. Tap :touch_sneak: to toggle block with the Shield.
translation: Dat Schild blockt dräpsende Schaad. Dat Schild kann in de Neven-Hand-Slot as ok in de Snellliest utreest warrn. Tipp :touch_sneak:, üm mit dat Schild to blocken.

source_string: -Collect Ink Sacs from Squids for Black Dye
translation: -Sammel Tintenblasen vun Tintenfischen för swaate Färv

source_string: The Crossbow is an alternate ranged weapon. Press and hold the screen to load the crossbow. Once the Crossbow is loaded, it will stay loaded until it is fired, even if you put it in your inventory. Press the hold the screen to fire an arrow. The Crossbow requires arrows to load.
translation: De Armbrust is en anner Fernwaap. Drük un hool den Schirm, üm de Armbrust to laden. So bold de Armbrust laden is, blifft se laden, bit se afschoten warrt, ok wenn du se in dien Taske leggst. Drük un hool den Schirm, üm en Piel to schoten. De Armbrust bruukt Piele, üm se to laden.

source_string: Visit this website on another device. %s

source_string: There is a new version of the game available, do you want to update to it to get all the new features?

source_string: What happens to my Realms and worlds when my subscription to Realms Plus ends?
translation: Wat passeert mit mien Realms un Wiälten, wenn mien Abo för Realms Plus utlöppt?

source_string: If your subscription ends, you and your friends will no longer be able to play online together on Realms, and you will no longer have access to the packs or cloud storage. You will be able to purchase and download any world templates saved to your Realm and cloud storage within 18 months of ending your subscription unless they are no longer offered by Minecraft. If you used Realms Plus worlds, texture packs, or mash-ups, you will need to purchase those packs in the store or, if those packs are still in Realms Plus, re-subscribe, to play those world templates.
translation: Wenn dien Abo utlöppt, kannst du un dien Fründ nich mehr tosamen online op Realms speelen, un du hest keen Togang mehr to de Pakete oder Cloud-Spieker. Du kannst all Wiältvörlagen, de op dien Realm un Cloud-Spieker sekert sünd, bit 18 Maand na dat Enn vun dien Abo köpen un daalladen, sülang se noch vun Minecraft anbaden warrt. Wenn du Realms-Plus-Wiälten, Texturenpakete oder Mash-ups bruukt hest, mööst du disse Pakete in'n Winkel köpen oder – wenn se noch in Realms Plus sünd – wedder aboneeren, üm disse Wiältvörlagen to speelen.

source_string: How many world templates can I play with Realms Plus?
translation: Wie vööl Wiältvörlagen kann ik mit Realms Plus speelen?

source_string: You can play and save ALL the packs included in the Realms Plus on your local device.  As well, you can host one of your world templates on a Realm for your friends to play with you for free!  You can change which world you load on your Realm anytime.
translation: Du kannst ALL Pakete, de in Realms Plus inbegrepen sünd, op dien lokaal Gerät speelen un sekern. Du kannst ok een vun dien Wiältvörlagen op en Realm hosten, so dat dien Fründ gratis mit di speelen köönt! Du kannst jedertiet wesseln, welk Wiält du op dien Realm laadst.
